ceiling: Configuration validation only, so it confirms compatible readers, unknown-field handling and the no-removal setting are declared; it does not show old and new readers interoperate.
offer: Check old and new readers against additive evolution and define unknown-field handling. Removing required fields breaks compatibility and needs a distinct versioned transition.

minimal.reason: List the old and new readers checked against the change. An empty list means compatibility was assumed, so name each consumer version.

mid.reason: Declare how readers treat unknown fields, such as ignore or reject. Undefined handling breaks forward compatibility, so state the rule.

maximal.reason: Set removal of required fields to false. Removing a required field breaks existing readers, so use a distinct versioned transition instead.
